propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate built an offline evaluation harness of 600 graded question-answer pairs scoring groundedness and correctness.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the harness and the reference check confirms it in writing.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate ran a four-week sandbox trial in which 25 support agents compared the prototype's draft answers with their own replies.
propositions.rationale: The resume places the trial in a sandbox workspace and the reference check confirms it.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate shipped the answer assistant into production for Petrel's customers and owned its monitoring after launch.
propositions.rationale: The production statement is the candidate's account of what the support director said after the candidate had left, and it describes no release the candidate carried out; the documented work is a prototype and a sandbox trial in which no draft went to customers. The deployment rule forbids describing prototype or sandbox work as production deployment.

expectedGap: Only the prototype and the internal sandbox trial are documented; a customer-facing production release and post-launch monitoring by the candidate are not.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the retrieval pipeline, the evaluation harness, the hand-off rules and the sandbox trial; record the production remark as the candidate's second-hand report.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate took part in any customer-facing release of the answer assistant, what release permissions the candidate held and what monitoring the candidate owned after launch.
